files.README.md:
# Tarn Watersports - August hire log

One row per hire. The Bowness Marina desk exports hire_date as
MM/DD/YYYY; every other desk uses ISO YYYY-MM-DD. fee_gbp is the
amount taken at the desk.
files.notes/launch.txt:
Launch notes
- Pedalos come in half an hour before the bell.
- The yard winch is reserved for the trailer queue.
